title: final clean integration carry manifest
integration_method: explicit path allowlist applied onto a fresh branch cut from the production base; no merge commit from any research branch
why_not_a_merge: a merge transfers every object the merged history reaches, including blobs that were committed once and deleted later. The research line committed a 65 MB residual parquet that is absent from every current tree and still reachable from those heads. An allowlist carries the files; it does not carry the history that reaches them.
superseded_handling: marked superseded, histories not merged; their evidence is carried as files and their hashes are recorded here. The V2 structural line is retired rather than merely unmerged: research/nba-game-latent-state-shadow-v2-structural and its base research/nba-game-latent-state-shadow-v1-bucket-repair are closed and deleted, and the only remaining copy of their history is an offline git bundle held outside the repository. So nothing in the two directories they fed may rely on being retrievable from another branch, and the compact provenance set below was carried before they went.
reachability_contract: none of the branches named above may be an ancestor of this lineage. Counting merge commits is the wrong proxy for that: GitHub tests a pull request on a synthetic merge of the head into the base, and merging this branch into production is itself a merge commit. Both join this lineage to production, which is the branch's purpose. What must never become reachable is a third lineage.

runtime_source.reason: the final accepted runtime: the simulator, the joint query engine, the shared-factor covariance assembly, the production shadow, and the containment guard

retraining_source.reason: required to reproduce the frozen factor spec from raw history: the role and bucket remediation layer, the count-transmission bridge, the PIT gaussianization, the factor fit, the acceptance gates and the exact joint pricer the temperature choice was made with

final_model_specification.reason: the authoritative specification of the frozen model and the four recorded dispositions

role_scale_selection_evidence.reason: the one role-scale ablation that selected the final role treatment, its pre-registered rule, and the holdout confirmation that proved equivalence to the already-graded model

retraining_drivers_and_evidence.reason: the pipeline that produces the residual dataset, fits the factors, freezes the spec and grades it; plus the evidence those runs emitted

control_lineage_evidence.reason: the accepted bucket repair is the control the final model is measured against, and the resolution directory carries the merge-path blob audit that CI enforces

rejected_structure_evidence.reason: the V2 structural study is carried as evidence only. There are no V2 runtime modules to exclude: the symmetric cross-player subspace, the additive role-deviation layer and the predictive-SD inflation were rejected and are absent from the frozen payload rather than present and disabled.

retired_lineage_compact_provenance.reason: the V2 line's own dependency record, manifest.equivalence.json, fingerprints an input it called v2_factor_spec.json that resolved to nothing on this branch, so the equivalence proof was documented but not checkable here. These five files close that gap without making any rejected dial reachable. factor_spec.json is the fingerprinted input itself; manifest.json records the run that produced it -- seed, code_sha, parameter counts and the exact v2_spec the rejected dials were set to; covariance_diagnostics.json is the fitted covariance evidence that spec describes; SHA256SUMS.factors.txt makes the set self-verifying; and 07b_diagnose_sd_blocker.py is the one V2 driver that imports nothing rejected, so the predictive-SD rejection stays executable. They are named individually rather than left to the directory entry above because they were carried deliberately, one file at a time, from a branch that no longer exists.

closed_study_evidence_only.reason: the count-space forensic study and the marginal-convention audit are both CLOSED with no parameter change adopted. Their reports are carried so the conclusions and hashes survive; their drivers are not, because nothing at runtime or in retraining calls them. Their .gitignore files are carried even though the drivers are not: both directories hold a ~56 MB untracked cache on a machine that has run the study, and dropping the ignore rules would leave that cache one 'git add -A' away from the merge path. An ignore rule that prevents a generated blob from being committed belongs on a production branch whether or not the thing that generates it does.

integration_record.reason: this manifest and the verifier that checks the tree against it. The verifier's own report is written by the run rather than listed as a prerequisite, so a first run on a fresh branch is not a failure.

production_documentation.reason: the production-facing record of what the shadow is, what it may not be said to be, and which original requirement was retired rather than met. It was declared in safety.DECLARED_INTEGRATION_PATHS while it was a pending protected-path change; the declaration was retired when it merged, because a declaration that outlives its change is standing permission to edit a production path unreviewed.

production_deployment.reason: the shadow's production entry point and the one non-blocking lifecycle step that invokes it. Both are recorded in safety.SHADOW_OWNED_PRODUCTION_PATHS; their declarations were retired when they merged, because a declaration is permission for a pending change and owning a path grants nothing. The entry point reads the marginals and copula the daily fit just wrote -- the objects the live pricing path prices with -- records what the candidate would have said, and publishes nothing. The workflow change is additive: every pre-existing step is unchanged and the added step is continue-on-error, so a shadow failure cannot fail the production lifecycle.

production_ops_closure.reason: the closure receipt and the live monitoring policy. The receipt reconciles the four pass/skip splits one commit has reported and records the production SHA both hashes were verified at; it needed a declaration while it was pending because it lives under ops/, and it is now recorded in safety.SHADOW_OWNED_PRODUCTION_PATHS instead, because the declaration was permission for a change that has landed. The policy fixes the live promotion thresholds before any live result exists. Neither decides production behaviour and neither grants promotion authority.

tests.reason: every test whose subject is carried

generated_datasets_and_model_binaries.reason: regenerable from the carried drivers, and the blob contract forbids them at any size
generated_datasets_and_model_binaries.note: none of these are tracked on any research branch; they are gitignored. Listed so the exclusion is declared rather than incidental.

forensic_experimentation_drivers.reason: not required at runtime and not required to retrain. The count-space forensic study is closed and its parameter change was not adopted, so the interval-censored estimator it was built on is dead code on a production branch.

retired_v2_search_space.reason: the four modules the rejected dials live in, and every V2 driver that imports one of them. Seven of the ten drivers do, including 07_prove_equivalence_and_calibrate_sd.py, so full executable reproduction of the V2 search paths cannot be carried without making the symmetric cross-player subspace, the additive role-deviation layer, the count-transmission bridge and the interval-censored count space constructible again on a production branch. That is an accepted and documented loss: the compact provenance set is carried instead, and the full history is held offline. Also excluded: the two superseded screening passes, whose accepted final form is already here as inner_screening.json byte for byte, and the two artifacts of the declined count-bridge work, which no retained record references.
retired_v2_search_space.enforced_by: tests/test_game_latent_state_shadow_clean_candidate.py asserts ModuleNotFoundError for each of the four modules and scans every carried module for an import of one

historical_large_blobs.reason: reachable from the research branch heads and carried by any merge commit; an allowlist cut from the production base cannot reach them

verification: no new blob in the merge path exceeds 10 MiB
no generated parquet, pickle or model binary appears anywhere in the merge path
every provenance hash recorded in final_model_spec.json resolves to a carried file
the full repository test suite passes on the integration tree
